SPECIAL
  AGENDA
  DEVELOPMENT REVIEW COMMITTEE

  City of La Verne
  Monday, February 25, 2019
  4:00 p.m. Conference Room
  3660 “D” Street

The Development Review Committee welcomes you. If all business is not
concluded by 11:00 a.m., your application may be continued to an adjourned
meeting date. Please advise staff if this poses any problem.

Items considered routine or not requiring full DRC review are posted weekly on
Tuesday mornings in the City Hall conference room for departmental review. The
public is welcome.
